newsitem.title: USA: Sharper Image Sept same store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Sharper Image Sept same store sales down.

text.p: Sharper Image Corp reported total company sales for September of $11.6 million, a five percent decrease from total sales of $12.1 million for Sept. 1995.
Comparable store sales were $7.6 million, compared to $8.7 million for last September, a 13 percent decrease.

For the eight months of fiscal 1996, total company sales were $103.4 million, five percent lower than the $108.5 million for the same year-earlier period. Comparable store sales decreased seven percent to $68.6 million from $73.5 million.
